ValidationRule.description: Code must match PRJ-YYYY-NNNN-XX with a sane year, XX equal to the name initials, a zero-padded non-palindromic serial and a hyphen at the right offset; names, notes and contact email get whitespace, case, ASCII, line-break and structural checks.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Code__c)), IF( REGEX(Code__c, 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}'), OR( VALUE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)) < 2000, VALUE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)) > YEAR(TODAY()) + 1, RIGHT(Code__c, 2) <> (UPPER(LEFT(Name, 1)) & UPPER(MID(Name, FIND(' ', Name) + 1, 1))), LPAD(TEXT(VALUE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4))), 4, '0') <> MID(Code__c, 10, 4), AND(MID(Code__c, 10, 4) = REVERSE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4)), VALUE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4)) > 0), RPAD(RIGHT(Code__c, 2), 4, '*') <> RPAD(UPPER(RIGHT(Code__c, 2)), 4, '*'), ASCII(MID(Code__c, 14, 1)) <> ASCII(CHR(45)), AND(Is_Approved__c, ASCII(RIGHT(Code__c, 1)) < 65) ), TRUE ) ), Name <> TRIM(Name), AND(Is_Approved__c, Name <> INITCAP(LOWER(Name))), AND(ASCII(LEFT(Name, 1)) >= 48, ASCII(LEFT(Name, 1)) <= 57), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Notes__c)), OR( LEN(Notes__c) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE(Notes__c, BR(), '')) > 50, CONTAINS(Notes__c, CHR(9)), LEFT(Notes__c, 1) = CHR(32) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled'), LEN(TRIM(BLANKVALUE(Notes__c, ''))) < 20), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Contact_Email__c)), OR( FIND('@', Contact_Email__c) < 2, LOWER(Contact_Email__c) <> Contact_Email__c, CONTAINS(MID(Contact_Email__c, MAX(1, FIND('@', Contact_Email__c)), 100), '..'), BEGINS(RIGHT(Contact_Email__c, MAX(0, LEN(Contact_Email__c) - FIND('@', Contact_Email__c))), '.') ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Phone__c)), NOT(ISNUMBER(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Phone__c, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '(', ''), ')', ''), '+', ''))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Project code, name, notes or contact email failed the string forensics checks.
